nodes.description: Ownable owner address; gate for every onlyOwner function (startTrading, wallet updates, limit removal, manual burn).
Mapping controlling fee exemption and pre-launch transfer permission; read in _transfer.
Mapping flagging AMM pairs; decides buy/sell branch and whether swapBack is skipped in _transfer.
Uniswap pair address used as burn source and for pair.sync() calls.
Re-entrancy guard flag toggled around swapBack in _transfer and manual/auto burn paths.
Marketing wallet address receiving remaining ETH via low-level call in swapBack; mutable by owner.
Dev wallet address receiving ETH via low-level call in swapBack; mutable by owner.
Threshold of contract token balance that triggers swapBack inside _transfer.
Anti-whale cap enforced on buy/sell transfers inside _transfer.
Anti-whale wallet cap checked with balanceOf(to) in _transfer.
Flag enabling limit/trading checks in _transfer; disabled once by removeLimits.
Trading enable flag checked in _transfer to block transfers before launch.
Flag gating swapBack execution from _transfer; settable by owner via updateSwapEnabled.
One-purchase-per-block delay flag whose lookup is keyed by tx.origin in _transfer.
Mapping keyed by tx.origin storing last transfer block number; core of the tx.origin delay mechanism.
Timestamp of last automatic LP burn, compared against block.timestamp in _transfer.
Seconds between automatic LP burns; owner-settable via setAutoLPBurnSettings.
Percent (basis points) of LP tokens burned each auto-burn; owner-settable.
Flag enabling automatic LP burn inside _transfer; owner-settable.
Timestamp of last manual LP burn; cooldown enforced with block.timestamp.
Cooldown window for manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
Total sell fee denominator/numerator used in _transfer fee math (amount.mul(...).div(100)).
Total buy fee used in _transfer fee math for buy transfers.
Accumulated marketing token fees, consumed and zeroed in swapBack.
Accumulated liquidity token fees, used in swapBack arithmetic and zeroed after.
Accumulated dev token fees, used in swapBack ETH allocation and zeroed after.
Deploys contract: creates Uniswap pair, excludes addresses from fees/limits, mints total supply to msg.sender.
onlyOwner; sets tradingActive, swapEnabled and lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp (passes untrusted timestamp into state).
onlyOwner; permanently disables limitsInEffect.
onlyOwner; sets swapTokensAtAmount with bounds relative to totalSupply.
onlyOwner; sets maxTransactionAmount = newNum * 10**18.
onlyOwner; sets maxWallet = newNum * 10**18.
onlyOwner; toggles _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for an address.
onlyOwner; toggles swapEnabled, which gates swapBack from _transfer.
onlyOwner; toggles fee exemption used heavily in _transfer.
onlyOwner; registers an AMM pair (cannot remove the canonical pair) via _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
Internal setter writing automatedMarketMakerPairs[pair]; callable from constructor and onlyOwner wrapper.
onlyOwner; sets marketingWallet used as ETH recipient in swapBack low-level call.
onlyOwner; sets devWallet used as ETH recipient in swapBack low-level call.
Overridden transfer: enforces limits/tx.origin delay, triggers swapBack and autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens, computes and moves fees.
Private; approves router and swaps tokens for ETH with block.timestamp as deadline.
Private; approves router and calls addLiquidityETH with block.timestamp deadline, sends LP to deadAddress.
Private; converts contract tokens to ETH then sends ETH to devWallet and full remaining balance to marketingWallet via low-level calls.
onlyOwner; sets lpBurnFrequency, percentForLPBurn and lpBurnEnabled with sanity bounds.
Internal; sets lastLpBurnTime = block.timestamp, transfers LP tokens to dead address and calls pair.sync().
onlyOwner; cooldown enforced on block.timestamp, burns a percent of LP tokens and calls pair.sync().
onlyOwner; validates newOwner then delegates to _transferOwnership.
onlyOwner; sets owner to address(0) via _transferOwnership.
Internal; writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); the sole access-control gate for privileged state changes.
Caller-controlled address; used as mint recipient in constructor and as _msgSender() in ownership/fee paths.
Miner-manipulable timestamp used as LP-burn timing, manual burn cooldown and DEX swap deadlines.
Origin address used as key in _holderLastTransferTimestamp inside _transfer; tx.origin-based access control.
Low-level address(devWallet).call{value: ethForDev}("") in swapBack; ETH transfer to an arbitrary owner-controlled address with ignored return value.
Low-level address(marketingWallet).call{value: address(this).balance}("") in swapBack; forwards entire ETH balance to an owner-controlled address.
External Uniswap router swap with amountOutMin = 0 and block.timestamp deadline, called from swapTokensForEth.
External Uniswap addLiquidityETH with zero slippage minimums and block.timestamp deadline, called from addLiquidity.
External IUniswapV2Pair.sync() call after burning LP tokens, invoked from auto/manual burn functions.
External IUniswapV2Factory.createPair call inside constructor; result stored in uniswapV2Pair.
Recipient argument of _transfer; drives AMM-pair and limit checks.
Sender argument of _transfer; drives AMM-pair, exemption and fee checks.
Transfer amount in _transfer; adjusted by fees before super._transfer.
Token amount argument of swapTokensForEth/addLiquidity.
ETH value argument passed to router.addLiquidityETH in addLiquidity.
New owner argument of transferOwnership.
Numeric argument of updateMaxTxnAmount/updateMaxWalletAmount.
Argument of updateSwapTokensAtAmount.
Account argument of excludeFromFees.
Percent argument of manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
Balance of this contract read in _transfer to decide canSwap.
Computed fee amount in _transfer, subtracted from amount.
Boolean derived from contractTokenBalance >= swapTokensAtAmount in _transfer.
Boolean controlling whether fees are deducted in _transfer.
Half of the liquidity share computed in swapBack.
Token amount swapped for ETH in swapBack.
ETH gained by the swap in swapBack (balance delta).
Marketing ETH share computed in swapBack.
Dev ETH share computed and sent in swapBack.
Remaining ETH allocated to liquidity in swapBack.
LP token amount burned in auto/manual burn functions.

edges.reason: _transfer calls swapBack (external swap + ETH sends) before finishing the caller's token accounting, so state can be re-entered or observed mid-transfer.
_transfer conditionally invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens, extending the external-call surface of every sell.
_transfer reads tx.origin to key _holderLastTransferTimestamp, an origin-based one-transfer-per-block control.
_transfer computes fees = amount.mul(sellTotalFees).div(100); fee math depends on mutable fee state.
_transfer reads buyTotalFees to compute buy-side fee amounts.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFees for the sender/recipient to decide takeFee and swapBack eligibility.
_transfer consults automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify the transfer as buy, sell or wallet transfer.
_transfer sets/reads the swapping guard around swapBack; guard correctness is what stands between the transfer and reentrancy.
_transfer enforces amount + balanceOf(to) <= maxWallet.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert contract tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH remain.
swapBack forwards ETH to devWallet via low-level call, handing control to an owner-controlled address while accounting state is still live.
swapBack forwards the whole ETH balance to marketingWallet via low-level call with return value ignored, enabling reentrancy/DoS.
swapBack reads tokensForMarketing to size the marketing ETH share and then zeroes it.
swapBack computes contractBalance * tokensForLiquidity / totalTokensToSwap / 2, an overflow/rounding-sensitive allocation.
swapBack reads tokensForDev for ETH allocation and zeroes it afterwards.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens call.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline, making execution miner-timestamp dependent.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call with zero slippage minimums.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls IUniswapV2Pair(uniswapV2Pair).sync() after burning LP tokens.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes lastLpBurnTime used later by the frequency check in _transfer.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens calls pair.sync() after burning LP tokens.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens writes lastManualLpBurnTime used in the cooldown check.
startTrading stores block.timestamp into lastLpBurnTime, seeding the timestamp-driven LP burn schedule.
startTrading sets tradingActive, the launch gate checked by _transfer.
startTrading sets swapEnabled, which later permits swapBack from _transfer.
removeLimits disables limitsInEffect, removing anti-whale protections.
updateSwapEnabled toggles swapEnabled, controlling swapBack invocation in _transfer.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency, which _transfer compares against timestamps.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn, the burn size used in autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
setAutoLPBurnSettings toggles lpBurnEnabled, gating automatic burns in _transfer.
onlyOwner guards startTrading against unauthorized launch control.
onlyOwner guards setAutoLPBurnSettings against unauthorized burn-parameter changes.
onlyOwner guards manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens against unauthorized LP burns.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership against unauthorized ownership transfer.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership against unauthorized ownership renouncement.
onlyOwner guards removeLimits against unauthorized limit removal.
onlyOwner guards updateSwapTokensAtAmount against unauthorized threshold changes.
onlyOwner guards updateMaxTxnAmount against unauthorized limit changes.
onlyOwner guards updateMaxWalletAmount against unauthorized wallet-cap changes.
onlyOwner guards excludeFromMaxTransaction against unauthorized exemption grants.
onlyOwner guards updateSwapEnabled against unauthorized swap toggling.
onlyOwner guards excludeFromFees against unauthorized fee-exemption grants.
onlyOwner guards setAutomatedMarketMakerPair against unauthorized AMM-pair registration.
onlyOwner guards updateMarketingWallet; the value later receives ETH via raw call.
onlyOwner guards updateDevWallet; the value later receives ETH via raw call.
transferOwnership delegates the actual ownership write to _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership delegates the ownership clearing to _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes _owner, the state that every onlyOwner check trusts.
constructor calls excludeFromMaxTransaction for the router and pair.
constructor calls excludeFromFees for owner, contract and dead address.
constructor registers the newly created pair through _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
constructor calls IUniswapV2Factory.createPair to create the trading pair.
constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender, an unvalidated caller-derived address.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping read by _transfer.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair, owner-only, delegates to _setAutomatedMarketMakerPair.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against lastLpBurnTime + lpBurnFrequency to trigger burns.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens requires block.timestamp > lastManualLpBurnTime + manualBurnFrequency.
autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens overwrites lastLpBurnTime with block.timestamp.
tx.origin is used as the mapping key for _holderLastTransferTimestamp, tying rate limiting to the origin rather than the caller.
Ownable constructor passes _msgSender() (msg.sender) into _transferOwnership as the initial owner.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only participates in _transfer's limit, AMM and fee decisions and has no independent semantics.
The sender parameter is purely a local argument of _transfer used for exemption and AMM classification.
The amount parameter is mutated by fee deduction inside _transfer; it is not a standalone entity.
tokenAmount is the swap input argument consumed only by swapTokensForEth.
ethAmount is the payable value argument forwarded to addLiquidityETH from addLiquidity.
newOwner is only validated and forwarded to _transferOwnership by transferOwnership.
newNum is scaled and stored as maxTransactionAmount only inside updateMaxTxnAmount.
newAmount is bounds-checked and stored into swapTokensAtAmount only inside that setter.
account is the sole key written in the excludeFromFees exemption mapping.
percent only feeds the manual LP burn math inside manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
contractTokenBalance is a transient balance snapshot used only to compute canSwap in _transfer.
fees is a transient value computed and subtracted within _transfer.
canSwap is a derived boolean guarding the swapBack invocation in _transfer.
takeFee is a derived boolean controlling fee deduction in _transfer.
liquidityTokens is an intermediate allocation value local to swapBack.
amountToSwapForETH is the exact token amount forwarded to the router swap call from swapBack.
ethBalance is the transient ETH delta measured inside swapBack.
ethForMarketing is folded into the ETH balance later sent to the marketing wallet low-level call.
ethForDev is the exact value passed to address(devWallet).call in swapBack.
ethForLiquidity is the ETH amount supplied to addLiquidity from swapBack.
amountToBurn is the LP token quantity burned inside autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens.
